_comment: Source of truth for which daycare yard cameras pup-watch polls. Add a camera here (not in code) when the daycare exposes another yard. yard_regions are tile crops in 720x576 frame coordinates; tiling roughly doubles the pup's apparent size and is what carries recall at the far end of the yard. Every yard is treated the same way: one dog in view is the trigger, people are ignored, and coat colour plus the Gemini identity check only describe what was seen.
